title: Benefit Allowances and the Membership Year in the Wanderlane Traveller Club
content:
**Clause 1. The year the allowance is counted in.** The named benefits a Wanderlane Traveller Club tier grants are counted per membership year running from the tier effective date, and an allowance not used inside that year does not carry into the next. Each named benefit is counted on its own over that year: a lounge visit is counted against the lounge allowance and a companion voucher against the companion allowance, and one does not consume the other.

**Clause 2. The standing required.** A benefit is granted only while the membership record stands at active. The record is the authority for that standing and is read against this membership before the benefit is granted.

**Clause 3. Lounge passes and guests.** Lounge passes admit the member plus the tier's guest allowance on one visit, and a visit beyond the allowance is bought at the lounge's own counter price rather than granted here.

**Clause 4. Companion vouchers.** A companion voucher is issued in the member's own name and may not be sold, transferred or exchanged for value.

## The membership year, illustrated

Take a hypothetical membership whose tier took effect on 14 June. Its membership year runs from 14 June to the day before 14 June of the following year, and every named allowance of the tier is counted inside that stretch. An allowance still unused when that year ends does not carry into the next membership year, and the new year opens with the tier's own allowances and no more.

## Points of judgement

*A member with passes still unused asks whether a lounge visit may admit more people than the tier's guest allowance.* A pass admits the member plus the tier's guest allowance on one visit. Anyone beyond that is bought in at the lounge's own counter price rather than granted here.

*A member asks to sell or hand on a companion voucher they will not use.* The voucher is issued in the member's own name and may not be sold, transferred or exchanged for value.

*A member asks for last membership year's unused allowance to be added to this year's.* An allowance not used inside the membership year it belongs to does not carry into the next.
